summary.text: One of the twelve suitors from Ithaca itself in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of Priam's augur son, attested only among Penelope's Ithacan wooers.

story.text: Apollodorus names Helenus among the twelve wooers of Penelope who came from Ithaca itself, listed with Antinous, Pronous, Liodes, Eurynomus, Amphimachus, Amphialus, Promachus, Amphimedon, Aristratus, Dulicheus, and Ctesippus — distinct from Helenus son of Priam, the Trojan seer.
